# crouter

> Universal resilient model router and gateway for Claude Code and coding agents with multi-provider failover, quota cooldown, and credential isolation.

crouter launches Anthropic Claude Code and native coding agents against audited Anthropic-compatible LLM providers without copying provider credentials into the repository. It keeps Token Plan keys, pay-as-you-go API keys, endpoints, auth headers, and model mappings as strictly separated routing surfaces. It detects upstream HTTP 401, 402, 403, and 429 failures in-flight and automatically fails over across candidate pools with exponential cooldown without dropping or restarting the agent session.

## System Metadata
- **Project**: crouter
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Luckycat133/crouter
- **License**: MIT
- **Version**: 0.5.3
- **Primary Runtime**: POSIX sh / dash / zsh / bash (zero daemon requirement for direct routes)
- **Supported Platforms**: macOS (native Keychain support), Linux, BSD
- **Core Integrations**: Anthropic Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot CLI

## Key Capabilities
- **In-Flight Multi-Provider Failover**: Catches HTTP 401 (Unauthorized), 402 (Insufficient Quota), 403 (Forbidden/Plan Exhausted), and 429 (Rate Limit) mid-session; retries next candidate without losing context or restarting agent processes.
- **Quota Cooldown Engine**: Temporarily places rate-limited or exhausted keys into cooldown (default 300,000 ms / 5 minutes or dynamic `Retry-After` header); sorts cooling keys to candidate tail to prevent wasted retries.
- **Credential & Process Isolation**: Uses hermetic `env -i` execution environments to prevent secret leakage into git logs or subshells; stores keys securely in macOS Keychain or mode-600 encrypted `.state` stores.
- **Dual-Surface Routing (Token Plan vs API)**: Strictly isolates vendor token plans (flat subscription pricing) from pay-as-you-go API keys (per-token pricing) across distinct endpoints, auth headers (`Bearer` vs `x-api-key`), and model mapping tables.
- **Unified Gateway Mode (`crouter all`)**: Lightweight local reverse proxy (`127.0.0.1:18799`) aggregating all configured providers into a unified `/v1/models` and `/v1/messages` surface; permits dynamic `/model <provider>/<model>` switching inside active sessions.
- **Managed Ephemeral MCPs & Skills**: Generates session-scoped mode-600 MCP configurations and vendor skills (MiniMax, Z.AI, DashScope, StepFun, etc.), enforcing `--strict-mcp-config` to eliminate cross-provider tool contamination.
- **Local & Native Backend Support**: First-class handling for Ollama (with 60-second SSE keepalive heartbeat relay and DeepSeek-V4 image-to-text fallback), MLX, Bonsai 2, Antigravity (Gemini/Claude), and native cloud SDK chains (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Azure Foundry).

## Supported Provider Ecosystem (36 Audited Providers)
- **Domestic Chinese Providers**: DeepSeek, MiniMax, Moonshot (Kimi), DashScope (Qwen), DashScope Coding, Baidu Qianfan, Qianfan Team, Qianfan Coding, Tencent Cloud (TokenHub), Tencent Coding, Z.AI (GLM), StepFun, Huawei Cloud ModelArts MaaS, Xiaomi MiMo, Qiniu AI, PPIO, InfiniAI, LongCat.
- **Global Gateways & Aggregators**: Anthropic Console API, OpenRouter, Fireworks AI, Requesty AI, Vercel AI Gateway, 302.AI, AIHubMix, NagaAI.
- **Local Inference & Reverse Proxies**: Ollama (DFlash2 / DeepSeek), Bonsai 2 (MLX Hadamard), Antigravity (Gemini 3.8/Claude), Antigravity Claude, Codex Proxy (`icebear0828/codex-proxy`).
- **Native Cloud Providers**: Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry.

## Core CLI Usage

```sh
# Launch Claude Code via specific audited provider route
crouter deepseek
crouter minimax
crouter dashscope qwen3.8-max

# Launch unified gateway with live /model switching
crouter all
crouter all --check

# Persistent target selection
crouter use minimax
crouter use app/codex
crouter run -p "Audit security posture"

# Provider catalog and environment diagnostics
crouter list --all
crouter doctor deepseek
crouter provider show dashscope

# Secure key management
crouter add minimax --surface plan
crouter list keys minimax

# Portable encrypted migration
crouter migrate export ~/crouter.crm
crouter migrate import ~/crouter.crm
```
